steps.title: An expression is a command
steps.text: Type any SysML expression at the prompt and the REPL evaluates it. There is nothing to set up first.

steps.title: Quantities carry their units
steps.text: Write a unit in brackets after a number. The REPL takes the units from the standard SI library and converts the result to SI.

steps.title: and the units are checked
steps.text: You cannot add a mass to a length. The REPL refuses the sum and names both units.

steps.title: Declare a model at the prompt
steps.text: A declaration typed at the prompt joins the session model. A block that is still open shows the ...> continuation prompt. The warning is real: the library's sum is declared over Real, and this model gives it masses.
input: part def Wheel { attribute mass :> ISQ::mass = 25 [kg]; }

steps.title: Derived values are evaluated on an instance
steps.text: car.mass is never written down anywhere. To evaluate it, the runtime makes an instance of car with four wheels and sums their masses into the body's.

steps.title: Hold an object and query it
steps.text: %instantiate keeps the object in the session. %eval in evaluates an expression with that object as its context.

steps.title: Calculations with typed parameters
steps.text: A calc def is a function whose parameters are typed. %calc calls it with quantities, and the result comes back in SI.
input: calc def Speed { in d : ISQ::LengthValue; in t : ISQ::TimeValue; return : ISQ::SpeedValue = d / t; }

steps.title: Look around
steps.text: %list prints what the session has declared. %search looks up names in the session and the standard library. Press Tab at the prompt to complete commands and names, and ↑ to bring back earlier lines.

steps.title: Load a model from the examples
steps.text: The page carries the runtime showcase models in an in-memory filesystem, so %load works the way it does on a disk. MassRollup defines totalMass recursively: a component's own mass plus the totalMass of each of its subcomponents.

steps.title: Roll up three stages and eleven engines
steps.text: No totalMass value appears anywhere in the file. Evaluating it builds the whole vehicle and computes the value at every level.

steps.title: A gap that only the runtime finds
steps.text: saturnVWithIU adds an instrument unit that declares a mass but never gives it a value. That is legal SysML, so validation finds nothing wrong. The rollup is where the missing value shows up.

steps.title: Print the element at fault
steps.text: %print prints any element as SysML notation, comments included.

steps.title: A delta-v budget
steps.text: DeltaVBudget applies the rocket equation to each stage of a Saturn IB and checks the total against an orbit requirement. The warning on load is genuine: the model calls the rocket equation in a way that leaves one parameter unbound.

steps.title: Call the rocket equation
steps.text: Specific impulse, standard gravity, wet mass and dry mass go in. Metres per second come out, because the units are carried through every step.

steps.title: Run the analysis case
steps.text: The analysis computes each stage's delta-v and the margin over the required speed, then decides its objective: the OrbitWithMargin requirement.

steps.title: Ask for more
steps.text: Arguments rebind the case's inputs. Require 400 m/s more and the verdict flips. The REPL prints the condition that failed.

steps.title: Sweep the requirement
steps.text: %sweep runs the case once for each value in a range and prints one row per run. The verdict changes between 9 250 and 9 500 m/s.

steps.title: Check every satisfy claim
steps.text: %satisfy evaluates each assert satisfy in the model against an instance of its subject.

steps.title: A crew-safety requirement
steps.text: Reliability multiplies e^(-λt) over the craft's components and requires the product to be at least 0.99. apollo flies for 195 hours. longStay flies the same hardware for 84 days.

steps.title: Decide the requirement
steps.text: One mission meets the requirement and the other does not. The REPL reports the condition that was violated and the instance it was decided on.
expect: Required condition evaluated to false: craft.reliability >= threshold

steps.title: An action flow with a decision
steps.text: LunarMission is a sequence of burns that spends a delta-v budget, with a decide node that skips the landing if too little is left after lunar orbit insertion.

steps.title: Start the action on an object
steps.text: Apollo 11 performs the mission. %action starts a debugger on the action, which waits with one token at the start.

steps.title: Step it and look at the token
steps.text: Each %step moves the token one node. %tokens shows where the token is and the value of remaining so far.

steps.title: Run it to the end
steps.text: Enough delta-v is left, so the decision takes the landing branch.

steps.title: Apollo 8 takes the other branch
steps.text: Apollo 8 carries 4 000 m/s less. The same flow run on that object skips the landing.

steps.title: The mission as a state machine on a clock
steps.text: MissionPhases moves through its phases with timed transitions, measured in seconds. %advance runs the simulation clock forward and reports where the machine is.

steps.title: Signals, parallel regions and a battery
steps.text: A ground station pings a spacecraft 30 s into the mission. The spacecraft answers with one 1 024-byte frame a second, and a parallel region drains its battery 2 % per frame. Below 80 % the battery recharges, and below 40 % transmission is interrupted.

steps.title: Advance 40 seconds
steps.text: The ping has arrived and the spacecraft is transmitting. Read the battery level off the running object.

steps.title: Advance another 40
steps.text: The battery has fallen below 40 %, so transmission is interrupted and the spacecraft goes into low power to recharge. The ground station has counted the frames that arrived.

steps.title: Run to the end of the transfer
steps.text: All 100 kB arrive by t = 241 s. %current also reports what the machine is still waiting for.

steps.title: Write a state machine
steps.text: A lamp that a Toggle signal switches on and off, and that switches itself off after 5 seconds.
input: transition first off accept Toggle then on;
transition first on accept Toggle then off;
transition first on accept after 5 [SI::s] then off;
part lamp { exhibit state s : Switch; }

steps.title: Start it
steps.text: %state attaches a debugger to the machine the object exhibits.

steps.title: Send it a signal
steps.text: %send posts the signal on the runtime's message bus, and advancing the clock dispatches it. The report shows the 5-second timer that is now pending.

steps.title: Let the timer fire
steps.text: Nothing is sent this time. The timer started on entering on fires at t = 5 s and switches the lamp off.

steps.title: Trace what the runtime does
steps.text: %trace on prints each exit, entry, evaluation and transition as it happens.

steps.title: Save, clear and load again
steps.text: %save writes the session model as SysML notation to this page's in-memory disk. %clear empties the session, and %load reads the file back in.
